sprat.title: Sprat
sprat.intro: Sprat workshops create intergenerational interactions, communication, and new experiences through creative expression.
sprat.detail: The source page describes Las Vegas teaching artists working with seniors and CORE Scholars using poetry, storytelling, theater, movement, painting, portraiture, sculpture, collage, and other art forms.

sections.heading: Connection, Sharing, and Creation
body: Scholars and staff facilitate creative workshops with senior citizens, including participants with brain and memory impairments, with activities adapted to individual ability levels.

sections.heading: What Scholars learn
body: The source page highlights respectful interaction with older adults, empathy, understanding the aging process, and alignment with school and after-school learning goals.

house-of-straus.title: House of Straus
house-of-straus.intro: Scholars attend six-week arts education lessons through the Joyce Straus Foundation for the Arts.
house-of-straus.detail: The source page says Scholars explore different art mediums—including pollution-solution art, stamp and print making, and painting—and present their work to the community at the end of each session.

sections.heading: Creative expression
body: The program gives Scholars structured opportunities to experiment with materials, make art, and share their work publicly.

score.title: SCORE
score.intro: The source-site inventory identifies SCORE as a summer-program page.
score.detail: Detailed current copy was not available in the retrieved source set used for this enrichment pass, so this route is retained as a review placeholder instead of inventing program details.

sections.heading: Retained for migration review
body: Before launch, confirm whether SCORE is active, historical, or should redirect elsewhere, then migrate the current approved description, eligibility, dates, and participation details.

donate.title: Donate / Support
donate.intro: CORE’s current site asks supporters to invest in a long-term, holistic model that combines school and community resources.
donate.detail: The source page offers online giving, mail-in donations, legacy gifts, advocacy, volunteering, and wish-list support.

sections.heading: Donate by mail
body: The current site offers a downloadable form for gifts by check. The final rebuild should link the verified current version.

sections.heading: Legacy gifts
body: The source page invites planned gifts including bequests, charitable gift annuities, stock, retirement-plan designations, and life-insurance beneficiary designations, and directs questions to Executive Director Jeff Jones.

sections.heading: Why support CORE?
body: The source page connects giving to economic mobility, social-emotional learning, and collective impact: helping Scholars and families access the support and opportunities needed for choice-filled lives.

sections.heading: Supporter voice
body: A donor testimonial on the current page emphasizes being able to see how gifts support children, families, and CORE’s whole-family model.

advocate.title: Advocate
advocate.intro: Advocacy helps CORE communicate its mission, raise funding, and broaden community impact.
advocate.detail: The current page encourages supporters to share CORE’s mission and social posts, attend events, take a tour, and talk with friends and family about poverty, inequity, and injustice.

sections.heading: Ways to advocate
body: Talk with your network about educational equity and opportunity
